strengths: Theorem 1: the original full review found the three fixed-entropy-order recovery thresholds supported by spectral tails, entropy-preserving truncation and admissible converse witnesses; necessity is established through assisted capacity, not independently for each unassisted capacity.

Proposition 4/Lemma 3: exact type subspaces enforce physical input energy for every encoded state and support arbitrary-index compound coding with genuinely uninformed users. The private-rate environment/secrecy accounting and fixed-E-first limit were checked.

Pointwise two-way sufficiency: the finite-codimension argument avoids infinite-energy forbidden-vector errors, and the cited distillation theorem includes seed payment. This remains an inherited pointwise result, not a common two-way code.

Theorem 7: matching known-noise and compound assisted minimax loss curves were checked uniformly over all finite budgets, with an all-input converse and valid endpoint clipping; no thermal optimizer for the mixed channel was assumed.

Theorem 8: the mixed-signal finite-rank Kraus-span detector, all-input entropy-deficit split, uniform kappa control including 1, and common code for unknown fixed (kappa,tau) survived the original audit; kappa remains bounded away from 0.

Original evidence coverage: all 14 exact PDF pages, all 3 principal TeX files, supplement README/all 6 programs and declared primary theorem/proof passages were read; all 35 manifest files matched and all 6 diagnostic outputs replayed byte-identically. These are historical review598 checks, not new checks performed in binding605.
